thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: anomalous billing spike detected for tenant=coraltech (vpc pool=ct-42). Metric: tokens_invoiced, window 16:05-16:25 UTC. Possible duplicate writes to accounting pipeline.

incident-bot: Alert ID: ALRT-2026-1804506789. Initial severity: P2 (customer-facing billing anomaly).

maya: I'm the on-call. Paging @leon @raj @oliver and looping in @emma for CS. coraltech_ops, can you confirm customer-facing symptoms?

coraltech_ops: Customer reports an unexpected billing email and elevated "estimated usage" in Console. They see a step increase around 16:12 UTC. No change in traffic on their side.

leon: Joining. Quick ask: is traffic actually higher or is this purely accounting?

raj: Billing team: raw request logs show normal request volume. Metering writes show multiple commit entries for same batch_ids. Running a query now.

oliver: Runtime: pulling metering-proxy logs and request traces. Suspect a race where proxy retries to legacy-metering backend on timeout while also writing to new-metering backend. I'll paste logs.

oliver: metering-proxy snippet:
```
2026-10-18T16:11:58Z metering-proxy INFO tenant=coraltech batch=0x9f2a ack_start
2026-10-18T16:11:59Z metering-proxy ERROR write timeout err=ETIMEDOUT route=legacy-metering
2026-10-18T16:11:59Z metering-proxy INFO forwarding to new-metering batch=0x9f2a tokens=640
2026-10-18T16:11:59Z legacy-metering INFO tenant=coraltech batch=0x9f2a recorded_tokens=640
2026-10-18T16:11:59Z metering-proxy INFO tenant=coraltech batch=0x9f2a recorded_tokens=640
```

oliver: It looks like both writes succeeded because the proxy did not gate on an idempotency check after a retry.

maya: Immediate mitigations: 1) prevent more duplicates, 2) stop billing aggregation for coraltech until we reconcile, 3) take a snapshot of metering events. leon, can you route coraltech away from fallback behavior?

leon: Applying routing policy lock to prevent fallback for coraltech pool ct-42. Command issued:
```
redwood route set --tenant coraltech --pool ct-42 --fallback disabled --reason "mitigate metering duplication" --ttl 60m
```
leon: Policy applied at 16:18 UTC.

raj: Pausing billing aggregation job for tenant coraltech. Command:
```
billingctl suspend-aggregation --tenant coraltech --until 2026-10-18T18:00:00Z --note "investigation metering duplication"
```
raj: Suspension confirmed.

infra-bot: Forensic snapshot started. s3://forensics/redwood/coraltech/1804506789/ job=snap-1804506789-1 ETA=3m.

emma: Notifying CoralTech primary contact: "We've isolated your traffic to prevent further accounting errors and are investigating. We'll follow up with corrected usage and any necessary adjustments." Sending now.

coraltech_ops: Customer asked if they should stop sending traffic. Confirmed that routing lock means their jobs will continue but not be double-accounted. They asked for invoice hold.

raj: Putting an invoice hold on the next billing run for coraltech. Command:
```
billingctl place-hold --tenant coraltech --until 2026-10-21T00:00:00Z --reason "metering dispute"
```
raj: Hold in place.

oliver: Hotfix plan: add strict idempotency enforcement in metering-proxy and enable via tenant-scoped feature flag. Patch already authored; will gate to coraltech and a couple of enterprise tenants first. Pseudocode:
```
if idempotency_index.contains(batch_id):
    log("suppress duplicate write", batch_id)
else:
    write_meter(batch_id, tokens)
    idempotency_index.add(batch_id)
```

oliver: Setting feature-flag: 
```
redwood feature-flag enable metering.strict_idempotency --tenants coraltech,delta-enterprise
```

oliver: Deploying metering-proxy v3.2.2-hotfix to us-west-2 (ct-42). Rolling deploy started.

infra-bot: Deploy dp-1804506789-1 started. Rolling update 2/5 nodes updated.

leon: Observability: after routing lock and flag, we see duplicate write rate drop to baseline.

raj: Reconciliation query (dedupe by batch_id):
```
SELECT COUNT(*) as dup_batches, SUM(tokens) as total_tokens_raw, SUM(DISTINCT batch_id, tokens) as deduped_tokens
FROM metering_writes
WHERE tenant='coraltech' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-10-18T16:05:00Z' AND '2026-10-18T16:25:00Z';
```

raj: Quick numbers: raw tokens recorded = 307,284; deduped tokens = 243,872; overcount = 63,412 tokens. Estimated monetary delta = $2.53 at current per-token rate.

raj: Opening billing adjustment ticket BILL-4799 with audit artifacts and the S3 forensic dump. CC finance and CS.

finance-bot: Created finance ticket FIN-2026-882. Noted provisional refund/credit required upon confirmation.

emma: Sending customer interim summary: "We have identified duplicated billing events, prevented further duplicates, and placed a hold on invoices. We're preparing a corrected statement and will confirm adjustment within 48 hours." Sending now.

oliver: Post-deploy logs show idempotency suppression entries for the duplicated batch_ids that used to write twice. No further duplicates for ct-42 after 16:22 UTC.

maya: Post-incident actions (short):
- enforce idempotency index for all metering writes (oliver)
- rollout metering-proxy hotfix to remaining pools within 24h (oliver + infra)
- backfill/dedupe job for any tenants that hit legacy fallback in last 7 days (raj)
- update runbook and add an automated routing-lock playbook for billing anomalies (leon)
- customer communications and finalize adjustment (emma + raj)

oliver: I'll schedule the full rollout and add integration tests that simulate a legacy fallback + metering path. ETA full rollout 36h.

raj: Will finalize BILL-4799 with final numbers and confirmation of adjustment. ETA 24h for customer-facing statement.

emma: I'll close customer loop after finance confirms credit. ETA 48h.

leon: Scanning for other pools still on legacy proxy versions; reporting 7 pools with older versions. Planning rolling updates after canary.

infra-bot: Canary deploy completed successfully. Full rolling update scheduled.

maya: Logging incident: INC-2026-1804506789 (sev=2) owners: maya, oliver, raj, leon, emma. Closing active mitigation. Keeping thread open for reconciliation and postmortem notes.

incident-bot: Incident recorded.

maya: Thanks team. If anything changes, post here and we'll escalate.
